responses.busy: A game is already running in this channel.
responses.hosting: You're already running a game in another channel. Finish that one first.
responses.request_channel: Games can't run in the music request channel: every message there is taken as a song request.
responses.rate_limited: You've hit your chat limit. Try starting a game again in {seconds} seconds.
responses.unavailable: The quiz needs the server's memories and a model, and one of them is not available right now.
responses.preparing: 🧠 {user} started a quiz with {rounds} questions about this server. Writing the questions…
responses.no_memories: I could not make any questions: there are not enough memories of this server yet (or none in that range).
responses.failed: Something went wrong and the game stopped.
responses.question_footer: Pick A–D within {seconds} seconds. Faster correct answers score more.
responses.chain_rules: 🔗 {user} started a word chain! Send one word that starts with the last letter of the word before. You can't play twice in a row, and words can't repeat. If nobody continues for {seconds} seconds, the game ends (I'll step in once halfway).
responses.chain_rules_homophones: 🔗 {user} started a word chain! Send one word that starts with the last character of the word before; a character with the same pronunciation also counts. You can't play twice in a row, and words can't repeat. If nobody continues for {seconds} seconds, the game ends (I'll step in once halfway).
responses.chain_no_homophones: (Same-pronunciation matching isn't installed on this bot, so only the exact character counts.)
responses.chain_out_of_quota: The host's chat limit is used up, so I can't keep playing. The chain ends here.
responses.chain_over: {count} words were played. The last word was **{last}**.
responses.song_need_voice: Join a voice channel first: the clips play there.
responses.song_unavailable: Music isn't available right now, so guess the song can't start.
responses.song_music_playing: Music is playing (or queued) on this server. Try again when it's done.
responses.song_other_game: A guess the song game is already running on this server.
responses.song_not_enough: This server needs at least {count} songs played with /play before guess the song works.
responses.song_preparing: 🎧 {user} started guess the song with {rounds} songs in {channel}! Type the song name (or the artist) here; the first right answer wins the round.
responses.song_interrupted: Someone started the music, so guess the song stops here.
responses.offer: 🎮 {user} wants to start {game}. Press Start to begin (valid for {seconds} seconds; only {user} can press it).
responses.offer_not_yours: Only the person who asked for this game can press this button.
responses.offer_limit: This server already has several game offers waiting to be answered; deal with those first.
